title: Investigate a successful, incorrect pipeline
requirement: Return violation_count as the sum of: missing plus unexpected order keys; NULL net_amount rows; duplicated order_id groups; joined order rows whose net_amount differs from the Source formula (including NULL); and daily FULL JOIN rows with missing dates, unequal order_count or unequal net_revenue. One daily row counts once even if both totals differ. Use Gold as the day-level baseline. A defect may contribute to more than one check.
learning_objectives: Combine independent checks across explicit grains
